title:
Re: Why I Quit Wall Street to Fix Healthcare: The Arbitrage of
 Compassion
description:
Hi Joah,

I concur with your about the finance bro.  I don't find that personality 
compelling or the person I want to hang out with. However, it is the 
perfect person to go after the insurance cartel or who I call Satan Inc. 
I am waiting to see how his moves forward with his future columns.  The 
insurance industry needs a reckoning.  This is why people resonate with 
Luigi Mangione.  I don't support him killing the United Healthcare CEO 
but I understand why he did it.

I've just purchased /Already Toast/. That is a good title of the book.  
Keep me posted on what you are finding in your market research.

Laura

> Joah

title: Reservation Reminder for East Potomac Golf Links - RED Course
description: 96 Confirmation# 425533063 Hi Esther Scott , Your reservation is tomorrow at 8:40 am. East Potomac Golf Links - RED Course Sunday, July 5, 2026 8:40 am 1 Player(s) A Note from National Links Trust: We are devastated to share that the Trump administration has terminated National Links Trust’s lease, effective immediately. In the short term, NLT has agreed to stay on as operators, allowing our courses to remain open and our hundreds of dedicated employees to stay in place. However, the future of affordable, accessible, high-quality public golf in the District is bleak. This is not the update we wanted to share. As a DC golfer, you know how special the East Potomac, Langston, and Rock Creek courses are. While this termination is a major setback, we remain stubbornly hopeful that a path forward can be found that preserves affordable and accessible public golf in the nation’s capital for generations to come. PlayDCgolf and NLT remain fully committed to honoring the legacies and principles of DC’s historic public courses. We hope that you stand with us and continue to share your love of DC public golf with friends, family, and beyond. Tee Time Cancellation Policy: Please log into the tee time booking portal at least 2 hours in advance to cancel or reduce the number of players to your tee time. Questions about your reservation? Call us at (202) 554-7660. Book Next Round Visit Our Website East Potomac Golf Links - RED Course 972 Ohio Dr SW, Washington, DC 20024, US (202) 554-7660 TM
